segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְחַלֵּל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת בְּדָבָר שֶׁחַיָּיבִין עַל זְדוֹנוֹ כָּרֵת, וְעַל שִׁגְגָתוֹ חַטָּאת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Also liable to be executed by stoning is «one who desecrates Shabbat by» performing «a matter that for its intentional» performance one is liable to receive «karet and for its unwitting» performance one is obligated to bring «a sin-offering.»

moves.summary: Stoning for Shabbat desecration carrying karet and a sin-offering

positions.claim: stoning applies to Shabbat desecration punishable by karet when intentional and a sin-offering when unwitting

unresolved.issue: biurHe empty for every segment of this sugya; move labels rest on the Aramaic and the English elucidation only
